sourceFacts.fact: Antibodies can bind platelets, promoting their clearance.
Reduced platelet production can also contribute; immune clearance is not the only mechanism.

nodes.shape: same oval with six abstract teal rounded antibody-marker tabs attached; no Y orientation
nodes.label: Antibody recognition

nodes.shape: large soft geometric C-shaped symbol enclosing the tagged oval
nodes.label: Immune clearance

checks: Exactly three main stages in the correct left-to-right order.
Antibodies touch the platelet surface; the clearance symbol encloses the coated platelet.
No spleen, vessels, organ silhouettes or microscopic tissue.
The secondary contribution of impaired production is stated.
Markers use abstract tabs rather than incorrectly oriented antibody Y structures.
validation.pixelReviewNotes: Full pixel-to-specification review: three stages run left to right; abstract teal tabs mark the platelet surface and avoid incorrect antibody-domain orientation. A geometric C surrounds the marked platelet; no spleen, organ or tissue is drawn. Reduced production is explicitly acknowledged. The first Y-shaped attempt was rejected and is not used.
